note: Grok Bot plugins/connectors referenced by this template. Not auto-configured in Pi; add equivalent MCP servers with `pi mcp add` or .pi/mcp.json.

plugins.name: Dropbox
plugins.description: The Dropbox plugin for Cursor connects your Dropbox files directly to Cursor, so you can search, reference, and organize files, save generated content, and create sharing links - all without switching tools. It respects your existing Dropbox permissions, and Cursor only works with files you already have access to.

plugins.name: Firecrawl
plugins.description: Web scraping, crawling, and search for AI agents. Gives Cursor full access to web content through the Firecrawl CLI.

plugins.name: Resend
plugins.description: Skills and MCP server for the Resend email platform — sending, receiving, templates, CLI, React Email, and deliverability best practices.
